post_copy.title: Stop using powder blush and dark pencils after 50 ❌ (Do THIS instead)
post_copy.caption:
I used to think my makeup was failing me until I realized I was using products tested on 20-year-olds with zero fine lines. 🤦‍♀️

When you're over 50, dry powders and heavy dark pencils settle into creases and drag your features down. The real secret is creating an elastic hydration grip with a botanical milky essence before applying a featherlight serum base.

Here is the exact anti-aging prep order:
1️⃣ Press a dewy milky essence into clean skin with warm open palms.
2️⃣ Apply a featherlight grip primer on high points.
3️⃣ Lift only the upper lashes to instantly open the eyes.
4️⃣ Finish with an age-defying botanical serum foundation that won't oxidize.

💬 Comment "LIFT" and your SKIN TYPE below for my complete mature skin prep routine! Make sure you follow so I can send you the guide!

⚠️ Note: Make sure you're following @botaniqueparis so my message can go through to your inbox!
